text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It happened when I went out shopping with 
Gran Alegria.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't this the place? Ai-chan's 
favorite shop!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, this is the brand! Oh, 
here's the handmade soap!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ooh, those girls are fans of Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? Gran-chan!? It's Gran-chan! Gran 
Alegria-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's Gran Alegria! Good 
morning-mile!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! Good morn-mile!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You knew who I was too! Ah, was it from 
the Yasuda Kinen I ran with Ai-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's Gran-chan's video! The one with her 
"My Rules" is so cute, I love it♡

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I watched the race video too! Winning even 
though it was hard to see out of your 
right eye is just incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I heard watching races live is amazing, so 
I'm planning to go see the upcoming 
Sprinters Stakes at the track for the 
first time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Woah, really?! Then I'm running in the 
Sprinters Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I know! It's the three-division conquest, 
right! The Sprinters Stakes is a short 
distance!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've already won the Yasuda Kinen for the 
mile, so all that's left is medium 
distance!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I wanted to learn more about Ai-chan 
and Gran-chan, and before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"And to even come watch my race, I'm eight 
miles happy♪"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"We're looking forward to it too! Do your 
best, Gran-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Wasn't that just amazing 
earlier!?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
They even knew about conquering three 
distance categories?! Even people who just 
recently started watching races!
choice_data_list:
Yeah! And on top of that, their passion 
was incredible...!

Yeah! And what's more, your passion was 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We uploaded the video intentionally, but 
it's spreading far beyond what we 
anticipated...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Watching a race for the 
first time, huh~♪ Which means—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Guess it's up to me to blow everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are— The Mile Queen is this 
blisteringly fast!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
With the scorching impact of 3.75 miles, 
let us burn you to ashes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a crowd! It's about 1.3 miles 
busier than usual!
choice_data_list:
Is it just me, or is the crowd really 
diverse...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I feel like there are a lot 
of casual fans here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Races featuring the nationally popular 
Almond Eye always had that tendency, but 
has that influence reached here as well?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
There are so many first-time spectators, 
it's got me thirty miles of fired up!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how should I run today~♪
choice_data_list: Go show them Gran's true worth!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes!
